name: wser-effluent-exceedance
description: At the start of a compliance year, will a federally regulated Canadian wastewater system report at least one effluent monitoring period whose average CBOD or suspended-solids concentration exceeds the limit that applies to it?
split_description: Fixed chronological boundaries by target year: train 2015-2019, eval 2020-2022, holdout 2023-2024. No embargo year is needed because each label window is a single non-overlapping calendar year and every feature is dated on or before 31 December Y-1, so no row can see a later row's outcome. Target year 2025 is excluded because its reports are still maturing in the current data vintage. Reporting-completeness strata and province are kept balanced across the three periods by construction of the year windows, not by resampling.
